abi_gate.reason: Exact 46 accepted atom row/name mapping is not available in current connected source context; placeholders deliberately prevent fabricated atom identities. Training admission requires manifest-bound materialization and pinned-tokenizer single-token verification.

canonical_reentry.consequence: Behavioral episodic binding and scientific self-adjudication remain separate curricula; this V2 is Stage-A binding data and cannot substitute for post-training causal adjudication or retention evidence.

falsifiers: A model performing well while codebook mappings are shuffled independently of targets would expose a dataset/loader leak.
Accuracy collapsing only on unseen vocabulary with intact codebook mechanics would indicate semantic lexical overfit rather than context-invariant binding.
Accuracy collapsing only on unseen symbol identities would indicate atom memorization rather than episodic variable binding.
Post-training semantic readability or symbol-write capability degrading beyond declared retention bounds falsifies the narrow-router specialization hypothesis.
Lesion of the learned binding route failing to selectively impair codebook choice, or rescue failing to restore it, weakens causal binder claims.
